_comment: Cenarios e construcoes na Forja (FORJA-09, ADR 0096). Nenhum numero do mundo nem dos atores e escrito aqui: a regua le-os dos ficheiros que o jogo usa (sources). As metricas sao fatores sobre essa regua, cada uma com a origem; as que dizem 'proposta' esperam pelo dono (Q-292). Pesquisa: docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/.

world.parallax_speeds: docs/art/NATIVE_SCENERY.md (ceu, nuvens, distancia, plano medio, marcos: 0,03125 / 0,07 / 0,125 / 0,25 / 0,5)

excluded.royal_dancer: galeria: a Bailarina nao circula no mundo de jogo (RUNTIME_ART, CV-05)

actors.origin: medido: body_bounds do manifesto V15, escrito por tools/export_royals.py

metrics.label: vao livre de uma porta comum (altura)
metrics.why: portas comuns medidas a 1,0-1,2x o ator (Stardew, Terraria; a porta real e 1,16x); abaixo de 1,05x parece apertada, acima de 1,3x o ator parece uma crianca (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: vao livre de uma porta comum (largura)
metrics.why: largura/altura 0,45-0,5 nas metricas reais e 3D; 32 px alinha com o tile (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: porta publica: forja, armazem, portao (altura)
metrics.why: portas publicas e monumentais medidas a 1,4-1,9x (Celeste, Kingdom Olympus, Hyper Light Drifter) (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: beiral de uma casa terrea (chao ao topo da parede)
metrics.why: porta, verga e parede acima; o Empire comprime mais do que Kingdom (2,1x) e Celeste (2,8x) (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: altura total de um edificio pequeno (cumeeira)
metrics.why: beiral e um telhado 2:1 sobre 128 px; coerente com o edificio pequeno de ~120x130 da Asset Bible (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: peitoril da janela, acima do chao
metrics.why: as cabecas das tropas cobrem so o terco de baixo da janela; a verga alinha com o topo da porta (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: altura da janela
metrics.why: minimo legivel de 8x10 px com moldura de 1 celula; maior compete com a porta (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: guarda, corrimao, balaustrada
metrics.why: a altura da anca: a guarda nao tapa o rosto de quem passa atras (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: espelho de um degrau
metrics.why: 3-4 celulas; o real e o Source dao 0,10-0,11x o ator (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: barril, caixote, bigorna (prop de trabalho)
metrics.why: trabalho a altura da mao; o barril ~0,5x o rei (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

metrics.label: centro de uma lanterna de parede
metrics.why: acima da verga e fora das cabecas (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))

building.en: side-elevation building standing on the walk line

wall_segment.en: repeatable side-elevation wall segment standing on the walk line

prop.en: side-view scenery prop standing on the walk line

tree.en: side-view tree with readable anatomy: trunk, structural branches, canopy masses, sky holes and contact roots

terrain_strip.en: repeatable side-view terrain strip: walkable top surface over a cut face of soil

plane_far.en: far parallax silhouette band, one flat value

plane_mid.en: mid parallax silhouette band, two flat values

foreground.en: foreground silhouette band, two flat values

asset_concept.label: conceito do asset
asset_concept.forbids: its resolution, brushwork and accidental defects

composition.label: composicao da cena
composition.carries: the relation of masses, the walk line, landmarks and open intervals
composition.forbids: collision, functional positions and any building it shows

style_master.label: mestre de estilo
style_master.carries: cluster size, edges, density and outline language

material.label: material
material.carries: how timber, stone, roof tile, foliage or water behave
material.forbids: spreading that pattern over the whole scene

junction.label: contexto de juncao
junction.carries: the neighbours, supports and continuity at the joint
junction.forbids: changing the neighbour outside the authorised region

actor_ruler.label: regua de atores
actor_ruler.carries: the visible body, weapon, support and clearance of the real actors
actor_ruler.forbids: shrinking the actors so the building fits

static.building: body, supports, openings and roof stay; furnace, smoke and activity may vary
static.tree: trunk, branches and roots stay; foliage and small linked motion may vary
static.water: level and banks stay; reflection, current and sparkle may vary
static.construction: origin and the volume of the planned level stay; exposed materials and progress marks vary
static.environment: geology and landmarks stay; light, weather and condition vegetation vary

signals.roof_pitch: the slope and the long low roof line
signals.eave_thickness: a thick eave with a shadow under it, separating roof from wall
signals.roof_trim: the ridge and gable trim that carry the people's identity
signals.door_opening: a doorway an actor can use: dark, clear, sill on the walk line
signals.chimney_join: the chimney joined to the roof and to its base, offset from the centre
signals.supports: posts, braces and beams that carry the roof down to the base
signals.foundation_anchor: a plinth or base that sits on the ground, no floating, no burying
signals.work_area: the work bay and tools that tell the craft
signals.canopy_silhouette: the canopy outline with its holes of sky
signals.trunk_anatomy: trunk, structural branches and the direction of growth
signals.contact_roots: roots and grass that tie the base to the ground

timber.motifs: long planks along the grain, end caps, knots, joints and braces
timber.focus: joints and edges facing the light

stone.motifs: a lit face, a side face, joints, cracks and protruding blocks

roof_tile.motifs: overlapping rows, a broken piece, ridge and eave
roof_tile.focus: silhouette, overlap and where water runs

thatch.motifs: bundled layers, a combed eave, ridge binding
thatch.focus: the eave edge and the ridge

soil.motifs: strata masses, dark pockets and roots
soil.focus: changes of plane and the limit of a cavity

foliage.motifs: a dark shadow pocket, connected mid-value leaf masses, few lit edge clusters, sky holes
foliage.focus: the lit edge and the holes

water.motifs: level line, broken horizontal reflections, current lines
water.focus: the bank and the reflected masses

brick.motifs: courses, an arch, soot over the furnace mouth
brick.focus: the arch and where heat marks it

enramados.architecture: structural timber, damp stone, roots around the supports

bruma.architecture: raised structures, reeds, contact with water

horta.architecture: shelters, stalls and grouped farm tools

portuarios.nature: open coast, rock and wind-bent plants
portuarios.architecture: quays, warehouses, salt, ropes and mooring gear

fenda.architecture: supports fixed to the rock, entrance trims

fornalha.architecture: brick and metal near the heat, localized soot

geada.architecture: eaves, roofs and access built against the weather

sobraiz.architecture: compact structures with organic, recognizable silhouettes

roof.steep_pitch: 1:1 (45 graus) para colmo, torres e frontoes
roof.origin: proposta FORJA-09 (Q-292); so passos regulares evitam escadas tortas (docs/art/research/2026-10-28-forja-cenarios/ (pesquisa A, §5.1))
roof.en: Roof: a regular pitch of about 2:1 (rise 1 cell for every 2 cells of run) built from equal steps; 1:1 only for thatch, towers or steep gables; no wobbly or irregular roof lines.
